title: Module skeleton boots
done_when: Prereq: C0 contracts. API and worker boot with fakes; each operation throws common.internal until its task (none returns 501); nav build passes; manifest produces: [] CI check green

title: Pure domain: state tables
done_when: every transition C1–C10, I1–I4, IR1–IR6, B1–B6 + one forbidden each has a unit test

title: Pure domain: AST value + interpretation
done_when: grammar table of 02-TRD §4.3 incl. ≤, 8/4, limits; all seeded codes accepted; cross-standard and restricted rejected; new synthetic code accepted without code change

title: Pure domain: breakpoint evaluation + selection + schedule
done_when: golden table (synthetic bands only) covers inclusive/exclusive, open bands, gaps, qualifier spanning, precedence levels; protocol/panel precedence; schedule maths

title: Coded sets + settings + plating-protocol config repositories and endpoints
done_when: M23–M28, M39, M40 pass HTTP contract tests; single x-permission micro.culture.read on the GETs (D-64); applies_to key clash → micro.code_duplicate; settings row created lazily (INSERT … ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO NOTHING, 08 A17 P-22); tenant shadowing works; SNOMED field optional

title: Consumer lab.specimen.status_changed.v1
done_when: received → culture; duplicate/stale/no-micro/aliquot (re-point sets last_specimen_seq; aliquot after setup creates nothing)/recollection/rejection paths; order_item_ids absent → specimen-type filter, ambiguity → no culture + metric; centre_id copied to children
tests: integration with LabPort/CatalogPort fakes; event contract (examples + extra fields + duplicate + stale seq)

title: Culture read endpoints
done_when: list filters/sorts/include_total; detail with lab_result only for lab.result.read; access-log action culture.view; *_display via ctx.core.memberships.list / ctx.core.user (D-47)

title: Setup, plates, observations
done_when: C2/C3 transitions; schedule fields; corrections; locks

title: Isolates
done_when: per-specimen numbering under concurrency (20 parallel creates → 1..20 unique; counter row lazy: INSERT … ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, specimen_id) DO UPDATE SET last_seq = last_seq + 1 RETURNING last_seq, 08 A17 P-22); identify/withdraw

title: AST panels + AST entry
done_when: panel precedence with tie-break (lowest code, then id); per-entry outcomes with SAVEPOINTs and path; category without raw value refused; off_panel; no operation sets report_visibility (AC-16.1, contract test over micro.yaml); p95 ≤ 300 ms for 60 entries on 10× seed

title: Breakpoint import endpoint + storage
done_when: Prereq: core ctx.uploads/ctx.storage (08 §4.13; fake storage until C0-0D ships). ctx.uploads.accept with bucket/objectPath (no separate put); upload checks (5 MiB = 5,242,880 bytes, UTF-8, NUL, sha256 dedupe → 422 micro.breakpoint_import_invalid); intended_effective_from stored; job enqueued; aal2 enforced

title: Breakpoint validation job + CSV parser
done_when: every issue code of 02-TRD §9.1 has a fixture; 20,000-line file ≤ 30 s; timeout path; a retried job leaves validating unchanged and succeeds

title: Breakpoint lifecycle + suggestions
done_when: four-eyes; overlap closing under concurrent activation (two parallel tx); preview never writes; accept_suggestion re-evaluation

title: Instrument record consumer + resolution
done_when: all match_status paths incl. ignored at IR1 and isolate_seq_out_of_range; mapped codes stored and reused on deferred apply; expires_at set on applied/ignored (D-65); ignore_comment stored; dedupe on key; conflict resolution; late after final; behind LIMS_MICRO_SPECIMEN_LOOKUP_PORT default false
tests: integration with synthetic events, contract, probes

title: Snapshot + submission
done_when: ajv-validated snapshot; size guard (20 isolates / 600 AST rows); snapshots exclude suppressed_by_rule rows (AC-16.1); single-tx with port; rollback on failNext; idempotent replay; guards; second preliminary over an approved preliminary sends module_preliminary_update (D-61); amendment_reason_* written to report_versions
tests: unit (snapshot), integration with LabPort fake (failNext for each passed-through code), contract

title: Reopen / amend / cancel
done_when: C8/C6/C9 transitions; amendment { reasonCode, reasonText? } per CR-C10-001 (module_phase_progression / module_preliminary_update auto-reasons); M17 checks reason format only, invalid reason surfaces as lab.module_result_invalid (D-62)

title: Published view contract
done_when: Prereq: C0 view. columns/order/JSON schemas; immutability; cross-tenant and centre probes

title: Reconciliation, metrics and purge jobs
done_when: all three tenantScope: per_tenant (P-6); cancelled line closes culture; flags when versions exist; batch bound; purge deletes only expired records not referenced by AST rows (D-65)
tests: integration with LabPort fake; purge integration

done_when: debounce preview, "Use" sets fields, per-row errors, unsaved-changes guard

title: Web: reports, reopen
done_when: drawer, disabled-state explanation (final and updated preliminary), error copy; reopen reasons exclude the three system codes (D-62)

title: Web: instrument data inbox
done_when: assign/apply/resolve/ignore dialogs; banner when port flag off

title: Web: settings + breakpoint tables
done_when: all tabs; import dialog (CSV accept: FileUpload accept += text/csv, 08 §4.6); detail polling; four-eyes copy

title: Security suite
done_when: every 07-SECURITY §5 test present and green
